en: A colored illustration of a traditional half-timbered parsonage seen through a large stone archway. There is a blossoming tree in the courtyard and additional historic buildings with red roofs and timber framing. The sky is blue and the style is that of a watercolor painting. Printed text in German appears beneath the image, and a handwritten-style signature with a date is visible in the lower right of the artwork.
